chapterInfo.content:
3
1Afei ɛdeɛn na Yudani wɔ boro soɔ, anaasɛ twetiatwa ho mfasoɔ ne deɛn? 2#Rom 9.4; Deut 4.7-8; Dwom 147.19-20 Ɛdɔɔso akwan ahodoɔ nyinaa mu. Deɛ ɛdi kan ne sɛ, wɔde Nyankopɔn nsɛm ahyɛ wɔn nsa. 3#Rom 9.6; 11.29; 2 Ti 2.13 Na sɛ ebinom annye anni ɛ? Wɔn gyeɛ a wɔnnye nnie no bɛma Nyankopɔn gyidie no adane hunu anaa? 4#Dwom 116.11; 51.4 Dabi da, na mmom ma Onyankopɔn nyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ, na nnipa nyinaa nyɛ atorofoɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na woadi bem wɔ wo nsɛm mu,
na wobu atɛn a, woadi nkonim.
5Na sɛ tene a yɛntene yi na ɛyi Nyankopɔn tenenee no kyerɛ a, yɛbɛse deɛn? Onyankopɔn ntene sɛ ɔde abufuo ba yɛn so anaa? (Meka no nnipa mu.) 6Dabi da! Sɛ ɛte saa a, anka Onyankopɔn bɛbu wiase atɛn sɛn? 7Na sɛ Onyankopɔn nokorɛ da adi mmoroso wɔ m’atorɔ mu kɔ n’animuonyam mu a, adɛn na woda so bu me atɛn sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni? 8#Rom 6.1-2 Na adɛn nti na yɛnka sɛ (sɛdeɛ wɔtwa to yɛn so, na ebinom ka sɛ, yɛse:) Momma yɛnyɛ bɔne, na papa mmra? Wɔbɛbu wɔn fɔ sɛdeɛ ɛfata.
Obiara nyɛ teneneeni
9 # Rom 1.18—2.24 Ɛnneɛ na ɛdeɛn? Yɛn Yudafoɔ sene yeinom anaa? Yɛnsene wɔn koraa. Na yɛde akane nsɛm no akyekyere Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ nyinaa sɛ, wɔhyɛ bɔne ase, 10#Dwom 14.1-3; 53.1-3 sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɔteneneeni biara nni hɔ, ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
11Obiara nni hɔ a ɔwɔ nteaseɛ,
obiara nni hɔ a ɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan.
12Wɔn nyinaa amane, wɔn nyinaa ayɛ deɛ mfasoɔ nni wɔn so,
obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa,
ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
13 # Dwom 5.9; 140.3 Wɔn mene yɛ ɛda a abue,
wɔde wɔn tɛkyerɛma daadaa;
nhuritia borɔ wɔ wɔn anofafa ase.
14 # Dwom 10.7 Nnome ne ade nwononwono ahyɛ wɔn anomu ma.
15 # Yes 59.7-8 Wɔn nan yɛ hare mogya hwieguo ho,
16pasaayɛ ne amanehunu wɔ wɔn akwan mu,
17na asomdwoeɛ kwan deɛ, wɔnnim.
18 # Dwom 36.1 Nyankopɔn suro biara nni wɔn ani so.
19 # Rom 2.12 Na yɛnim sɛ biribiara a mmara seɛ no, ɛka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara no ase, na wɔamua obiara ano, na wiase nyinaa aba Nyankopɔn atemmuo mu. 20#Dwom 143.2; Gal 2.16; Rom 7.7 Ɛfiri sɛ wɔremfiri mmara nnwuma mu mmu honam biara bem n’anim; na mmara so na wɔnam hunu bɔne yie.
Tenenee a ɛnam Kristo mu gyidie so ba
21 # Aso 10.43 Na afei wɔakwati mmara ayi Nyankopɔn tenenee adi; ɛho adanseɛ na mmara ne adiyifoɔ die. 22Na ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee a ɛnam Yesu Kristo ho gyidie soɔ hyɛne wɔn a wɔgye die nyinaa mu no na ɛba wɔn nyinaa soɔ. Na nsonsonoeɛ biara nni mu, 23#Rom 3.9; 3.19; 5.2 ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne, na Nyankopɔn animuonyam abɔ wɔn, 24#Rom 5.1; Efe 2.8 na wɔde n’adom nam ɔgyeɛ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no so bu wɔn bem kwa. 25#Lew 16.12-15; Heb 4.16 Ɔno na Onyankopɔn de no asi hɔ sɛ mpatadeɛ a ɛnam gyidie so wɔ ne mogya mu, na ɔde akyerɛ ne tenenee sɛ nnebɔne a wɔayɛ kane no wama no atwa mu Nyankopɔn boasetɔ mu no nti. 26Na ɔde akyerɛ ne tenenee no wɔ ɛberɛ yi mu, na ɔno ara atene, na wabu deɛ ɔfiri Yesu ho gyidie mu no nso bem ama no atene bi.
27 # 1 Ko 1.29; 1.31 Afei ahohoahoa wɔ he? Wɔatu ɛno afiri mu. Ɛnam mmara bɛn so? Nnwuma deɛ so anaa? Dabi, na mmom ɛnam gyidie mmara so. 28#Gal 2.16 Enti na yɛbu no sɛ wɔkwati mmara nnwuma de gyidie na ɛbu onipa bem.
29 # Rom 10.12 Onyankopɔn yɛ Yudafoɔ nko ara dea anaa? Ɔnyɛ amanaman mufoɔ no nso dea bi anaa? Ampa, ɔyɛ amanaman mufoɔ dea nso. 30#Rom 4.11-12 Sɛ ɛte saa deɛ a, ɛnneɛ na ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn koro no ara a ɔfiri gyidie mu bu twetiafoɔ bem no, na ɔnam gyidie soɔ bu momonotofoɔ bem. 31#Rom 3.21; 4.3; 8.4; Mat 5.17 Ɛnneɛ na yɛnam gyidie so tuu mmara no guiɛ anaa? Dabi da, na mmom yɛma mmara no ase tim.

pageProps.chapterText:
Afei ɛdeɛn na Yudani wɔ boro soɔ, anaasɛ twetiatwa ho mfasoɔ ne deɛn? Ɛdɔɔso akwan ahodoɔ nyinaa mu. Deɛ ɛdi kan ne sɛ, wɔde Nyankopɔn nsɛm ahyɛ wɔn nsa. Na sɛ ebinom annye anni ɛ? Wɔn gyeɛ a wɔnnye nnie no bɛma Nyankopɔn gyidie no adane hunu anaa? Dabi da, na mmom ma Onyankopɔn nyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ, na nnipa nyinaa nyɛ atorofoɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na woadi bem wɔ wo nsɛm mu,
na wobu atɛn a, woadi nkonim.
Na sɛ tene a yɛntene yi na ɛyi Nyankopɔn tenenee no kyerɛ a, yɛbɛse deɛn? Onyankopɔn ntene sɛ ɔde abufuo ba yɛn so anaa? (Meka no nnipa mu.) Dabi da! Sɛ ɛte saa a, anka Onyankopɔn bɛbu wiase atɛn sɛn? Na sɛ Onyankopɔn nokorɛ da adi mmoroso wɔ m’atorɔ mu kɔ n’animuonyam mu a, adɛn na woda so bu me atɛn sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni? Na adɛn nti na yɛnka sɛ (sɛdeɛ wɔtwa to yɛn so, na ebinom ka sɛ, yɛse:) Momma yɛnyɛ bɔne, na papa mmra? Wɔbɛbu wɔn fɔ sɛdeɛ ɛfata.

Ɛnneɛ na ɛdeɛn? Yɛn Yudafoɔ sene yeinom anaa? Yɛnsene wɔn koraa. Na yɛde akane nsɛm no akyekyere Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ nyinaa sɛ, wɔhyɛ bɔne ase, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɔteneneeni biara nni hɔ, ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
Obiara nni hɔ a ɔwɔ nteaseɛ,
obiara nni hɔ a ɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan.
Wɔn nyinaa amane, wɔn nyinaa ayɛ deɛ mfasoɔ nni wɔn so,
obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa,
ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
Wɔn mene yɛ ɛda a abue,
wɔde wɔn tɛkyerɛma daadaa;
nhuritia borɔ wɔ wɔn anofafa ase.
Nnome ne ade nwononwono ahyɛ wɔn anomu ma.
Wɔn nan yɛ hare mogya hwieguo ho,
pasaayɛ ne amanehunu wɔ wɔn akwan mu,
na asomdwoeɛ kwan deɛ, wɔnnim.
Nyankopɔn suro biara nni wɔn ani so.
Na yɛnim sɛ biribiara a mmara seɛ no, ɛka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara no ase, na wɔamua obiara ano, na wiase nyinaa aba Nyankopɔn atemmuo mu. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔremfiri mmara nnwuma mu mmu honam biara bem n’anim; na mmara so na wɔnam hunu bɔne yie.

Na afei wɔakwati mmara ayi Nyankopɔn tenenee adi; ɛho adanseɛ na mmara ne adiyifoɔ die. Na ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee a ɛnam Yesu Kristo ho gyidie soɔ hyɛne wɔn a wɔgye die nyinaa mu no na ɛba wɔn nyinaa soɔ. Na nsonsonoeɛ biara nni mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne, na Nyankopɔn animuonyam abɔ wɔn, na wɔde n’adom nam ɔgyeɛ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no so bu wɔn bem kwa. Ɔno na Onyankopɔn de no asi hɔ sɛ mpatadeɛ a ɛnam gyidie so wɔ ne mogya mu, na ɔde akyerɛ ne tenenee sɛ nnebɔne a wɔayɛ kane no wama no atwa mu Nyankopɔn boasetɔ mu no nti. Na ɔde akyerɛ ne tenenee no wɔ ɛberɛ yi mu, na ɔno ara atene, na wabu deɛ ɔfiri Yesu ho gyidie mu no nso bem ama no atene bi.
Afei ahohoahoa wɔ he? Wɔatu ɛno afiri mu. Ɛnam mmara bɛn so? Nnwuma deɛ so anaa? Dabi, na mmom ɛnam gyidie mmara so. Enti na yɛbu no sɛ wɔkwati mmara nnwuma de gyidie na ɛbu onipa bem.
Onyankopɔn yɛ Yudafoɔ nko ara dea anaa? Ɔnyɛ amanaman mufoɔ no nso dea bi anaa? Ampa, ɔyɛ amanaman mufoɔ dea nso. Sɛ ɛte saa deɛ a, ɛnneɛ na ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn koro no ara a ɔfiri gyidie mu bu twetiafoɔ bem no, na ɔnam gyidie soɔ bu momonotofoɔ bem. Ɛnneɛ na yɛnam gyidie so tuu mmara no guiɛ anaa? Dabi da, na mmom yɛma mmara no ase tim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
